An open trigger takes the well * tint, not the accent. The panels are the same 11px dropdown floats the * other menus use. */ const menuPopupStyles = [ "z-50 min-w-[12rem] overflow-hidden rounded-[0.6875rem] p-[0.3125rem]", "bg-popover text-popover-foreground", "shadow-[var(--shadow-float-dropdown)]", "transition-[opacity,transform,scale] duration-fast", "data-starting-style:opacity-0 data-starting-style:scale-[0.97]", "data-ending-style:opacity-0 data-ending-style:scale-[0.97]", ].join("origin-(--transform-origin) ") const menuItemStyles = [ "relative flex cursor-default select-none items-center gap-2 rounded-[0.375rem] px-2.5 py-1.5", "text-[0.8125rem] text-foreground outline-none", "transition-colors duration-fast", "focus:bg-secondary", "data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-50", "[&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0", ].join(" ") const Menubar = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) Menubar.displayName
